tasks_completed.description: Registered Task and Agent in toolFullViewRegistry
tasks_completed.changes: Added Task: TaskViewFull and Agent: TaskViewFull entries to toolFullViewRegistry so that getToolFullViewComponent('Agent') and getToolFullViewComponent('Task') return TaskViewFull instead of null
tasks_completed.rationale: PRIMARY fix. When clicking an Agent/Task tool card, the detail view fell back to generic layout (Description + Input + Output) because the registry had no entry for Task/Agent. Now it renders TaskViewFull which shows sidechain children.

tasks_completed.description: Added isCuid gate for CUID2 parent references in reducerTracer
tasks_completed.changes: Added import of isCuid from @paralleldrive/cuid2; changed condition from `!isUuidLike(parentUuid)` to `!isUuidLike(parentUuid) && !isCuid(parentUuid)` at line 289
tasks_completed.rationale: SECONDARY fix. CUID2 parent references from session protocol subagent field were treated as standalone (immediately emitted without sidechainId) instead of being buffered as orphans for later parent resolution. Now CUID2 references are properly buffered.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - toolFullViewRegistry was created with only MultiEdit entry, Task/Agent were never added
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: When toolFullViewRegistry was introduced, only MultiEdit was registered. Task and Agent tool cards were added to toolViewRegistry (card view) but not to toolFullViewRegistry (detail/full view).
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Fix 1 adds Task and Agent to the full view registry so clicking their cards renders TaskViewFull with sidechain children. Fix 2 ensures CUID2 parent references are properly buffered as orphans instead of being emitted as standalone messages.
